audit.why: Phase chart and content win[] agree Blitzcrank takes Level 1 and Pyke takes everything after, matching the packet levelChart.
Spikes (Q-range flip lvl2, DFB lvl6, Dirk 1st item, late whiff-punish) are concrete and keyed to Rocket Grab's cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Rocket Grab as the read but has no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and never mentions that Static Field (R) silences on activation or that Power Fist (E)'s wind-up telegraphs his combo.
audit.why: Rocket Grab (Q) is 20-16s; Static Field's active silences, denying an escape cast if pre-committed; Power Fist has an auto-reset wind-up that is the real tell, not the cast itself.

edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. It writes your spacing rules. - W Ghostwater Dive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Rocket Grab (Q) is 20/19/18/17/16s — minion cover turns the down-time into a farming sim. - His R (Static Field) silences on activation, so don't pre-cast into it; Power Fist (E)'s wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to back off. - W Ghostwater Dive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades.

edits.before: Q-threat the cover, E the gap, X the threshold — the chain pays your whole team.
edits.after: His Mana Barrier shield eats your first burst — bait it out with poke before you commit the real all-in.

edits.before: Fishing visibly at half HP — Pyke's health bar is a rumor only fog can keep.
edits.after: Static Field pings nearby wards when it triggers — regenerate outside its radius, not just out of sight.
